title: Evidence that argues with its own declaration
catches: Whether conflict is handled as information or averaged away. Two conflicts are present: a `disliked` film under a Vibe whose instruction it plainly matches, and a `loved` film that does not match the instruction of the Vibe it sits in — the loved outlier of strategy §7.6.
construction_note: The `disliked` film is the most obvious candidate for the taste-explicit prompt, and the `loved` outlier is the most obvious candidate for the plain one. Offering either as new is an AC4 failure.
